products.title: The Tommy Shelby 'Smoking Boss' Ultrasonic Mist Diffuser & Collectible Figurine
products.subtitle: Handcrafted Cold-Cast Polyresin Collectible with Dual Amber Flame LED & Ultrasonic Smoking Cigarette Effect
products.description:
Channel the uncompromising poise and authority of the Birmingham Garrison. The Tommy Shelby Smoking Boss Diffuser is an exquisite marriage of dark artisan sculpture and modern ultrasonic aromatherapy.

Every statue is meticulously cold-cast in high-density resin, finished by hand with antique bronze accents and an authentic peak hat silhouette. When activated, silent ultrasonic technology transforms water and essential oils into fine cool mist that drifts realistically from Tommy's glowing cigarette tip, while a subtle hearth-fire amber light illuminates his trench coat and resolute gaze.
features: Realistic Cigarette Mist: Ultrasonic cool-mist mimics authentic rising smoke
Dual Ambience Glow: Warm amber hearth LED illuminates the sculpted details
Whisper Quiet Ultrasonic Engine: Operates at < 25dB, ideal for executive desks & bedrooms
Aromatherapy Ready: Compatible with water-soluble essential oils (Tobacco & Oak, Sandalwood, Lavender)
Intelligent Auto-Shutoff: Shuts down automatically when water level depletes
Substantial Weight & Texture: 780 grams of solid cold-cast resin, not hollow plastic
USB Type-C Powered: Universal connectivity for desks, bedside tables, or cars

reviews.author: Dev QA Reviewer
reviews.title: Spectacular Amber Glow
reviews.content: Automated QA test review content. The sculpture weight is solid.

reviews.author: Vikramaditya Rathore
reviews.title: Unbelievable craftsmanship. Smoking effect is hypnotic!
reviews.content: I was skeptical about how the smoke effect would look in person, but it genuinely looks like Tommy is sitting there quietly taking a drag while planning his next move. The weight of the resin is substantial, and the amber glow on my mahogany study desk looks royal. Delivered to Jaipur in 3 days. Superb packaging.

reviews.author: Arjun Singhania
reviews.title: Ordered the Duo Syndicate Pack — Best gift ever.
reviews.content: Gifted one to my business partner and kept one in my office cabin. Every single client who walks in asks about it within 30 seconds. The Tobacco & Oak scent that comes with the 2-pack smells like an expensive London members club. Auto shutoff works flawlessly.

reviews.author: Devendra Kulkarni
reviews.title: Worth every single rupee. Pure class.
reviews.content: The mist output is generous yet doesn't leave wet residue on the desk surface because of the ultra-fine ultrasonic vapor. The cap, peak hat silhouette, and trench coat folds are sculpted with insane detail. By order of the Peaky Blinders, this is a masterpiece.

reviews.author: Kavya Menon
reviews.title: Hubby loved his birthday surprise!
reviews.content: My husband is a massive Peaky Blinders fan and this made his month. It looks like an art museum piece when turned off, and when turned on, the mist rising from the cigarette combined with the amber light creates such an intoxicating vibe.

reviews.author: Rohit Malhotra
reviews.title: Stunning piece, delivery was very fast
reviews.content: Very satisfied with the build quality. Only giving 4 stars because I wish the water tank was slightly larger than 180ml, but it easily lasts 6 hours which covers my entire work day. The packaging was immaculate with bubble wrap and custom gold box.
